rationale: The Court is most likely to reverse unanimously on narrow Article III grounds—lack of plaintiff-specific traceability and redressability for forward-looking injunctive relief—while vacating the overbroad injunction. Separate concurrences are most likely to debate the proper jawboning/state-action standard under Bantam Books and Blum/Lugar and to caution against (or invite) future, more targeted suits on a clearer coercion record.
